reason: A DSH Web plugin that adds a settings panel listing archived conversations and provides limited read-only previews of recent messages without switching or modifying sessions.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 设置面板中列出已归档对话，并提供最近消息的只读预览。
summaries.en: Adds a DSH Web settings panel for listing archived conversations and viewing limited read-only previews of recent messages.

capabilities: Displays archived conversation entries in a DSH Web settings panel
Reads and returns limited recent user and assistant message text for archived sessions
Registers a same-origin read-only preview route for the web host
